verdict.rationale: Smooth is a hosted browser-agent service, so choosing the underlying LLM is a fair question for it. The only model-related evidence says Smooth runs its own 'small and efficient AI models', and nothing documents configuring a third-party or user-supplied LLM provider. The CLI working with any calling agent (Claude Code, OpenClaw, others) is an adjacent integration feature, not bring-your-own-model support inside Smooth.
